name: Creamy Cashew Zucchini Noodles with Vegan Sausage, Artichoke & Spinach
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a small saucepan, starting with hot water from the tap.) In a small heat-safe bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove to a plate and cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the sausages are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a large bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add zucchini, artichokes, and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the veggies to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain cashews and place in a blender.
Juice lemon into the blender with the cashews. Add broth, nutritional yeast, flour, and spices to the blender; purée on high until the sauce is smooth.
Add sauce and sausage to the skillet; stir to combine with the veggies. Continue to cook, stirring often, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggies, sauce, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
